name: contract-audio-retention
goal: Retain class-generated audio in revision-bound proof and Examples with failures and provenance intact

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: TestArtifactService writes registered WAV artifacts and transcripts, but focusedScreens filters out audio and readRegression only decodes images. Earlier capture tests checked stored bytes and notes, never the sealed capture/history boundary, so generated class examples disappear.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Extend the existing single TestArtifactService.capture initialized case through gathering, focused retention and sealed history reading. Keep playable bytes, transcript, unit/case/revision/hash, failure outcomes and invalid binding checks in that same method case; retain all existing byte-snapshot and invalid-prop assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Retained red 86364a3ca50b at test-only 1bda78322134 on harbor-mbp-2. The unchanged single artifact method case observes [0,0] retained audio, a sealed-reader decode rejection and four accepted forged bindings before asserting. Compiler, full lint, audit and five generated-project cases pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Retain decoded audio through the same focused evidence pipeline as screenshots, with registered unit/case, revision/hash and declared scenario binding. Keep audio free of screenshot viewports and HTTP-server assumptions. Reuse exact stored bytes and validate the sealed media kind and audio provenance before projecting history; preserve original statuses.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Committed 37096c026eaf retains decoded class audio with declared unit/case/state/slot, tested revision, media hash and transcript. Audio is not assigned a screenshot viewport or HTTP server identity. The Git reader validates WAV kind and provenance; old image checks and statuses stay intact.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched harbor-mbp-2 red 77a3588bbfaa at 1bda78322134 fails the same single existing method case; green cfc1e6939d4a at 37096c026eaf passes. Both records retain the original d62864e6ea73 WAV and source-bound class/case notes. Tests, fixtures, authored expectations, command and environment are unchanged.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The clean original product snapshot 1bda78322134 fails retention, sealed-reader decoding and forged-binding observations; repaired 37096c026eaf passes unchanged. Both failing/passing records preserve playable bytes and outcomes. Diagnostic qualification passed compiler, full lint, registry, audit and 32 method, CLI screenshot/history, generator, ownership and readability checks on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
